parsed.explanation: Lemma 4 reduces the lower bound to the existence of a vertex set V_T with signs whose signed sum Ξ of original piece lengths satisfies |Ξ| ≤ Σε_i + [M odd]a_M. This is the entire content of L3.3 beyond the trivial (3.1) computation, and the write-up supplies only the phrase 'standard; details omitted'. The needed edge-count (at most n pairs among n+1 vertices, so some component is a tree), the bipartition of that component, and the telescoping estimate of |Ξ| by the slacks appear nowhere else; §3 only proves the signed-subset-sum bound (3.1), and §5 concerns the upper bound. Supplying the missing argument requires a new lemma, not a local edit.
